tier_compliance.reason: “Notice ... the same number of particles but different masses” invites observation without explaining or applying the science, as Tier 1 requests.

visual_grounding.reason: The hint identifies the particles in the two samples and their differing mass labels (46 u and 26 u).

scientific_correctness.reason: Both samples contain ten particles, and the labeled masses per particle differ; the hint makes no incorrect scientific claim.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Noticing the particle masses is relevant to comparing kinetic energies and does not direct the student toward an incorrect choice.

answer_disclosure.reason: It does not identify which sample has greater particle mass or temperature, or rule out any option.

actionability.reason: The student can immediately compare the particle counts and labeled particle masses, while retaining the kinetic-energy and temperature reasoning.
